meta.title: Richmond BC — the Chinese food meta
meta.subtitle: Where the scene actually is, summer 2026
meta.intro: A working, evidence-based map of Richmond's Chinese food scene — organized by hub and daypart, not one citywide popularity list. Every entry carries a confidence level and a last-verified date. SEED DATA extracted from research notes; being verified against current Chinese-language sources and official hours.

hubs.name: Empire Centre
hubs.summary: Strongly lunch-weighted food court (~97% popular-times at 1–2pm Sun). Key stalls close 6–7pm, so it is a lunch/early-afternoon destination, not a late-night one. Off-peak 3–4pm eases seating but risks sellouts/reduced menus.

dayparts.breakfast: HK breakfast at Cha Don / One Cafe draws lines by 9:30–10:30
dayparts.late: Only Loon Fong Hotpot and a few full-service tenants

hubs.name: Aberdeen Centre
hubs.summary: Polished mall dining; strong dim sum on the 3rd floor. Busy at lunch and the early 5:00–6:30pm dinner rush, but can feel deserted near closing.

hubs.name: Alexandra Road (Food Street)
hubs.summary: The dinner / group dining / late-night spine. Where local sources point night diners. Strong for regional (non-Cantonese) full-service and communal formats.

hubs.name: Capstan Village
hubs.summary: Newer plazas near the Capstan Canada Line station; repeatedly cited for dinner and late-night. Emerging cluster to verify.

hubs.name: Yaohan Centre / Richmond Public Market
hubs.summary: Yaohan's court has been declining for years; Richmond Public Market is currently a weak general recommendation. Easy to misread — treat as timing-sensitive/legacy.

hubs.name: Parker Place
hubs.summary: Known benchmark for BBQ / roast-meat and bakery takeaway.

restaurants.name: Empire Seafood Restaurant
restaurants.address: Unit 200, London Plaza, 5951 No. 3 Road, Richmond, BC V6X 2E3
restaurants.goodToKnow: Standalone room. Online reservations and an early 9am open make it the easiest low-crowd option. May 2026 locals praise the less-cramped room and SkyTrain view.

restaurants.name: Continental Seafood Restaurant
restaurants.goodToKnow: Standalone room — Richmond's only remaining push-cart dim sum. The most distinctive experience. A 10am reservation may get carts before the peak crush.

restaurants.name: Fisherman's Terrace Seafood Restaurant
restaurants.goodToKnow: Aberdeen Centre, 3rd floor. Long-running polished Cantonese benchmark with repeated 2026 recommendations.

restaurants.name: Chef Tony Seafood Restaurant
restaurants.goodToKnow: In Empire Centre. Modern, higher-end dim sum with specialty items and longstanding awards. Google ~3.9 (1,840).

restaurants.name: Golden Paramount Seafood Restaurant
restaurants.goodToKnow: Standalone, smaller technique-focused room with a concise menu and strong reputation among Chinese Restaurant Awards judges.
cautions: Conflicting posted hours — verify by phone

restaurants.name: Jade Seafood Restaurant
restaurants.goodToKnow: Standalone. Tourism Richmond currently advertises 20% off before 11:00am — a possible alignment of value, freshness, and lower crowds.
cautions: Confirm early seating is fully operational

restaurants.name: Lanxuan
restaurants.goodToKnow: Chef received a recent Dim Sum Chef of the Year honor — a potential updated-meta pick that could displace a legacy room.

restaurants.name: Yue
restaurants.goodToKnow: Repeatedly named by experienced local diners as a current favorite.
cautions: Official info + dish evidence still incomplete

restaurants.name: Cha Don
restaurants.goodToKnow: Empire Centre stall. Named a Hong Kong breakfast destination; weekday and especially weekend morning crowds reported. Google ~4.0 (250).

restaurants.name: One Cafe
restaurants.goodToKnow: Empire Centre stall. Hong Kong-style fast food; draws morning crowds. Google ~4.4 (298).

restaurants.name: Cloud 9 Delicacy
restaurants.goodToKnow: Empire Centre stall. Taiwanese-style sets; unusually high Google ~4.7 (421) worth verifying against dish-level reports.

restaurants.name: Double Double Restaurant
restaurants.goodToKnow: Empire Centre. Long-running inexpensive HK-style restaurant. Google 3.6 with 1,580 reviews — read as a busy volume institution, not a weak spot.

restaurants.name: Sanbo Chinese Restaurant
restaurants.goodToKnow: Empire Centre. Cantonese cha-chaan-teng style. Google ~4.0 (555).

restaurants.name: Loon Fong Hotpot
restaurants.goodToKnow: Empire Centre. Late-night hours. Google 4.9 with 1,543 reviews — an unusually high score worth auditing for review-acquisition patterns.

restaurants.name: Meeting in Chang'an
restaurants.goodToKnow: A Xi'an roujiamo stall reported (May 2026) being built in a converted Empire Centre unit, per the owner's RED post. Represents non-Cantonese, migration-driven range.
cautions: Opening not verified — was awaiting inspection
